AddItemRequest.title: AddItemRequest
AddItemRequest.description: Adds a line to a note's checklist. Like an edit, it carries no version.

ChangeDisplayNameRequest.title: ChangeDisplayNameRequest
ChangeDisplayNameRequest.description:
Request body for changing the current user's display name. Carries no
version: the concurrency token travels only in the `If-Match` header.

CreateUserRequest.title: CreateUserRequest
CreateUserRequest.description: Request body for creating a user.

EditNoteRequest.title: EditNoteRequest
EditNoteRequest.description:
Replaces a note's title and body. Carries no version: the concurrency token
travels only in the `If-Match` header, never the body (see the handlers).

requestId.description: The same id as the `x-request-id` header.

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description: One input at fault. `path` names it as the client sent it (e.g. `title`).

ListResult_NoteResponse.title: ListResult_NoteResponse
ListResult_NoteResponse.description: The paging fields are present only when the list was paged.

ListResult_NoteSummaryResponse.title: ListResult_NoteSummaryResponse
ListResult_NoteSummaryResponse.description: The paging fields are present only when the list was paged.

ListResult_UserResponse.title: ListResult_UserResponse
ListResult_UserResponse.description: The paging fields are present only when the list was paged.

archivedAt.description:
When the note was archived, because its author was deleted. An archived
note can't be edited or deleted.

items.description:
Its checklist, in the order the items were added. An item is part of
the note: changing one changes the note's version.

version.description:
Optimistic-concurrency version. Echo it back in `If-Match` to edit this
note; a stale value is refused with `412 Precondition Failed`. Also
mirrored in the `ETag` response header for single-item reads.

authorName.description: The author's display name; absent when no user has the note's author id.

UserResponse.title: UserResponse
UserResponse.description:
A user as exposed over HTTP. Ids and timestamps are strings so the generated
client stays dependency-free (uuid/RFC3339 as plain `string`).

version.description:
Optimistic-concurrency version. Echo it back in `If-Match` to change this
user; a stale value is refused with `412 Precondition Failed`. Also
mirrored in the `ETag` response header for single-item reads.

JwtAuth.description:
JWT Bearer security scheme: the token verified, then resolved to the [`Principal`] acting. A
Module's operations take its `Caller` instead, which passes its gate too.
